name: Image Viewer
description: View images from your remote server with zoom and fit controls.
author: TermLoop

reviews.author: Priya S.
reviews.comment: Opens straight from the file manager — exactly what I needed for checking upload results on a headless server.

reviews.author: Marcus L.
reviews.comment: Simple and fast. Would like rotate/crop but the zoom controls cover most of what I need.

reviews.author: devops_dana
reviews.comment: No more scp-ing screenshots just to look at them. Great little utility.

name: Docker
description: Manage Docker containers and images on the connected server
author: TermLoop

reviews.author: kubernetes_kyle
reviews.comment: Docker Desktop-style UI right inside the SSH session. Install-Docker flow saved me a manual setup on a fresh box.

reviews.author: Ana R.
reviews.comment: Container start/stop/restart all work reliably even over a laggy connection.

reviews.author: hb_ops
reviews.comment: Does what it says. Would love image pruning next.
